model.note: four real specimens on disk, configs read from their own files

model2_vs_vl_variant.meaning: reuse here is NOT a similarity heuristic -- the emitted MSL is the same bytes, so the kernel transfers by construction and the forge cache key hits exactly, meaning the TUNING is reused too

model2_vs_falcon.meaning: a genuinely different architecture shares nothing, which is what makes the 100% case meaningful rather than automatic

result.what_the_curve_shows: Specimen 1 (Qwen3-30B-A3B) learned all 5 organ shapes with compounding UNDEFINED, because compounding is meaningless at N=1 and the pass says so rather than reporting 0%. Specimen 2, the VL variant of the same MoE core, reused 5 of 5 -- 100%. Specimen 3, Falcon-H1, reused 0 of 4. Specimen 4, Kimi-VL, reused 2 of 5. So compounding is REAL, ARCHITECTURE-DEPENDENT, and PARTIAL in between -- it is not a smooth curve and claiming one would be false.

both_educational_goals.how_it_wants_to_EXIST: NOT DISCHARGED by this pass for any of them; that is Gravity's question, carried for model #2 under G023 and not attempted for the other three

CORRECTED_BY_LATER_MEASUREMENT.what_was_incomplete: 'the emitted native MSL is BYTE-IDENTICAL BY SHA-256 between model #2 and the VL variant (b17f0bad44a2bf90), so the kernel transfers BY CONSTRUCTION' is true only of a tensor the VL variant does not store. On disk it keeps experts as fused 3-D tensors with gate and up interleaved and the gate half transposed; that tensor emits cf7e64009d5d47be. Byte-identity requires a de-interleave and transpose the pass did not count.
CORRECTED_BY_LATER_MEASUREMENT.and_the_ranking: 100% went to the specimen whose storage diverges most, while the 40% specimen (Kimi-VL) shares model #2's storage convention exactly and differs only in row count. The reuse figure ranked architecture-config similarity, not the property that decides kernel transfer.
CORRECTED_BY_LATER_MEASUREMENT.what_stands: The Falcon zero, the (organ, shape) cache key, and the transfer of representation fidelity (cosine 0.993952 vs 0.993965). The kernel HAS now been run on the VL variant's real weights and is correct at 3.815e-06.

claim_boundary: Compounding is measured on ORGAN SHAPES and the kernel-identity check upgrades that from a proxy to byte-identical emitted source for the one case tested. What is NOT shown: no kernel was RUN on the VL variant's actual weights, no Doctor verification was done on any specimen but model #2, and reuse of a SHAPE does not prove the representation is ADEQUATE for that model -- local adequacy does not compose, and these specimens have not been graded at all. Three of the four have had no Gravity work whatsoever. Knowledge level ARCHITECTURE for the shape-transfer finding, which is as far as four specimens on one machine can support.
